shots.key: close-up portrait of Aurel, a warm human man in his thirties with curly warm-brown hair and a short beard, laughing eyes, a cheeky half smile as if about to laugh, simple cream linen shirt, warm summer window light

a small sunny room above a shop on a summer evening, Aurel, a curly-haired man in his thirties in a cream linen shirt, sits on a stool for a painter, fidgeting and pulling a funny face, the painter's easel in the foreground, warm golden light
shots.motion: the man fidgets on the stool and pulls a face, the painter's brush pauses, warm dust in the light, gentle slow camera push

shots.key: a woman in her early thirties with dark brown hair tied back, a fire-warden's canvas coat, a leather helmet under her arm, leaning in a doorway and laughing warmly, summer evening light behind her
shots.motion: she laughs and shakes her head fondly, her shoulders move, soft light flickers, slow gentle camera drift

shots.key: daylight inside the black ruin of a burned house, a young woman fire-warden in a soot-streaked leather helmet kneels beside a grizzled old fire-warden who points with a gloved finger at a charred beam pattern, ash on the ground, shafts of grey light
shots.motion: the old fire-warden traces the char pattern with his finger, the young woman leans closer and studies it, ash drifts in the light beams, slow camera move

shots.key: night, perfectly still black harbour water like a mirror, the reflection of a distant orange fire glowing in it, moored boats silhouetted, no wind
shots.motion: the orange reflection slowly grows brighter in the still water, a faint shimmer, very slow camera tilt up

shots.key: night, a big timber warehouse on a wharf fully ablaze, the smoke rising perfectly straight up into a windless sky, a young woman fire-warden with an axe stands at the edge of the wharf in silhouette against the flames, too late
shots.motion: flames roar and sparks rise straight up, smoke climbs vertically, the woman's shoulders drop and the axe hangs from her hand, slow push in

shots.key: grey dawn, rain beginning, a soot-blackened young woman fire-warden sits on the wet edge of a wharf with a coat around her shoulders, staring at a smoking burned ruin, muted cold colours
shots.motion: rain starts to fall, smoke drifts from the ruin, she stares without moving, a slow breath, very slow camera drift

shots.key: close-up of a magistrate's desk, a thin case file and an insurance ledger with a red wax seal, an old man's hand in a black sleeve brings down a heavy rubber stamp, grey window light, dusty
shots.motion: the hand brings the stamp down on the file, dust lifts in the light, the ledger page settles, slow camera

shots.key: dusk, a bright white villa among dark cypress trees on a hill, warm windows glowing with a party inside, a plump rich man raising a wine glass and laughing at a window, in the dark foreground a lone woman in a coat stands by the iron gate watching
shots.motion: the party windows glow and figures move inside, the plump man laughs and raises his glass, the woman by the gate stays still, slow push toward the windows

shots.key: a dim candlelit office with no sign on the door, a stern woman in her fifties with long silver hair in a black high-collared coat sits behind a desk and slides a brass lantern across it toward the viewer, rain on the window behind her
shots.motion: the silver-haired woman slides the brass lantern across the desk and studies the viewer, candlelight flickers, rain runs down the window, slow camera push

shots.key: close-up of a brass lantern held up in a dark doorway, its warm light falling on an old wooden doorframe where a faint pale violet shimmer clings to the wood, a woman's face half lit behind the lantern, narrowed eyes
shots.motion: the lantern light sweeps slowly across the doorframe and a faint pale shimmer glows where it touches the wood, the woman's eyes narrow, very slow motion

shots.key: dawn over a foggy harbour city of slate roofs and masts, huge crimson banners hanging from the warehouses, in the foreground a gilded painted portrait of a laughing bald merchant king with a moustache and furs hangs in a marble hall window overlooking the docks
shots.motion: crimson banners unfurl and ripple in the breeze, fog drifts over the harbour, gulls cross the sky, slow camera pan across the city

shots.key: a great round white temple with a dome on a hill above the rooftops catching the first sun, in the narrow street below a hooded figure pulls the hood lower as a temple guard in white and gold armour walks past, morning light
shots.motion: the dome glows in the rising sun, the guard walks past, the hooded figure tugs the hood lower and turns away, slow camera tilt down from the dome to the street

shots.key: a candlelit office copying room, a young clerk with tousled brown hair and round spectacles in a burgundy waistcoat sketches at a desk with ink on his fingers, behind him a bald old watchman with a big moustache and a clay pipe leans in the doorway unimpressed, a ginger cat asleep on a box
shots.motion: the clerk sketches quickly, the old watchman puffs his pipe and smoke curls, the cat's ear twitches, candle flickers, slow camera drift

shots.key: before dawn in a small attic room under a sloped roof, a woman in her forties with shoulder-length dark brown hair in a brown leather coat asleep at a desk over open ledgers, one candle, grey light at the small window, rain on the glass, a brass lantern on the desk, a small painted portrait on a cabinet
shots.motion: the candle gutters, rain runs down the window, the sleeping woman breathes slowly and begins to stir, very slow camera push
